Senses.PreferredTarget: the cypress tree before the courtyard
AlternateTargets: the cypress tree in the garden
the Chinese arborvitae before the hall
SearchAliases: tree in front of the hall
Senses.Explanation: The cypress tree standing before the courtyard—Zhaozhou Congshen's answer to the stock question “what is the meaning of the Patriarch's coming from the West?” (如何是祖師西來意). The headword names the cypress or Chinese arborvitae of temple yards, not an oak. In Zhaozhou's own record the questioner objects, “Master, do not show people by way of an object” (和尚莫將境示人); Zhaozhou says, “I do not show people by way of an object” (我不將境示人), and repeats the same answer. Elsewhere Zhaozhou is asked whether the cypress has buddha-nature (柏樹子還有佛性也無) and when it becomes a buddha; he answers that this occurs when empty space falls to the ground. The exchange became a named case repeatedly raised from the teaching seat. Wansong Xingxiu re-presents it for verse-commentary; Wuzu Fayan says understanding it one way is wrong and another way right; Yuanwu Keqin gives the bare phrase to Anmin, who immediately penetrates it; Dahui Zonggao calls Zhaozhou's answer exceedingly direct. Wansong's commentary also preserves Huijue's denial: after being challenged with the widespread report, Huijue says, “My late teacher really had no such saying; do not slander him” (先師實無此語。和尚莫謗先師好). The Zen deployment therefore includes answer, named case, attached handling, awakening trigger, explicit appraisal, and denial of the case's own attribution.
Senses.Note: The older English rendering “the oak tree in the garden” is a mistranslation: the source term names cypress or Chinese arborvitae, not oak. The headword denotes the same cypress answer and named case throughout; the distinct handlings do not create different lexical things.

Occurrences.Kwic: 時有僧問：「如何是祖師西來意？」師云：「庭前柏樹子。」學云：「和尚莫將境示人。」師云：「我不將境示人。」云：「如何是祖師西來意？」師云：「庭前柏樹子。」
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Sayings Record of Zhaozhou Congshen (趙州和尚語錄): Zhaozhou Congshen gives the cypress answer twice and rejects the objection about showing an object.

Occurrences.Kwic: 問：「柏樹子還有佛性也無？」師云：「有。」云：「幾時成佛？」師云：「待虛空落地。」云：「虛空幾時落地？」師云：「待柏樹子成佛。」
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Sayings Record of Zhaozhou Congshen (趙州和尚語錄): Zhaozhou Congshen answers questions about the cypress's buddha-nature and becoming a buddha.

Occurrences.Kwic: 僧便問。如何是祖師西來意。州云。庭前柏樹子。僧云。和尚莫將境示人。師云。不將境示人。僧云。然則如何是祖師西來意。師云。庭前柏樹子。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Book of Serenity commentary (萬松老人評唱天童覺和尚頌古從容庵錄), case 47: Wansong Xingxiu re-presents Zhaozhou Congshen's cypress case for verse-commentary.

Occurrences.Kwic: 五祖示眾：如何是祖師西來意？庭前柏樹子。恁麼會則不是了也。如何是祖師西來意？庭前柏樹子。恁麼會方始是。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Old Cases Collection (宗門拈古彙集), Wuzu Fayan section: Wuzu Fayan raises Zhaozhou Congshen's case and contrasts wrong and right ways of understanding it.

Occurrences.Kwic: 悟曰。你問我。師舉前話。悟曰。庭前柏樹子。師即洞明。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Five Lamps Compendium (五燈會元), Anmin section: Yuanwu Keqin gives Zhaozhou Congshen's cypress phrase to Anmin, who immediately penetrates it.

Occurrences.Kwic: 承聞趙州有柏樹子話是否。覺曰。無。眼曰。往來皆謂。僧問如何是祖師西來意。州曰。庭前柏樹子。上座何得道無。覺曰。先師實無此語。和尚莫謗先師好。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Book of Serenity commentary (萬松老人評唱天童覺和尚頌古從容庵錄): Wansong Xingxiu presents Huijue's denial that Zhaozhou Congshen ever gave the cypress saying.

Occurrences.Kwic: 如僧問趙州。如何是祖師西來意。州云。庭前柏樹子。這箇忒殺直。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Sayings Record of Chan Master Dahui Pujue (大慧普覺禪師語錄): Dahui Zonggao raises Zhaozhou Congshen's cypress answer and calls it exceedingly direct.
